title: Finance Project Analyst
description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. We combine an open Agentic AI Platform with AI-Native IT Solutions to help telecommunication providers transform, innovate, and deliver results that matter. Powered by cutting-edge technology—and the passion of our people—we unlock new opportunities, spark innovation, and create better digital experiences for millions worldwide. Join us and be part of a team that is not just keeping up with the digital future—we’re leading it.

About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Role & Responsibilities

  • Act as a key contact for interpreting and investigating financial results for assigned projects
  • Prepare, reconcile, analyze, and report project KPIs
  • Review actual and planned resources, flag discrepancies to Project Managers
  • Handle project closeout reconciliations and escalate issues as needed
  • Analyze financial and business data for assigned projects and contracts
  • Coordinate with Project Managers on change orders, project status, resourcing, and budgets
  • Assist in developing regular financial status reports for projects
  • Record monthly revenue for contracts and communicate estimates to clients
  • Monitor subcontractor and vendor contracts, acting as the contact point for external/internal resources
  • Attend project meetings to support Project Managers and ensure accurate forecasting
  • Track overall project health, including revenues, gross profit, receivables, and project closeouts
  • Ensure that operational procedures are being followed by Project Teams
  • Identify and work with team leads to resolve and/or escalate violations as needed
  • Validate reports obtained from projects and ensure that the reports are provided on time
  • Work with project team leads and program directors on operational support needs, set up and lead project meetings
  • Assist with Resource plan baselines
  • Review and manage exceptions and escalate to stakeholders as needed
  • Process and distribute reports, defining tool requirements
  • Analyze and monitor dashboard reports on every project created monthly
  • Identify planned projects monthly
  • Identify projects with Level of Effort (LOE) overage and escalate these to senior management
  • Schedule invoices and assist in their payment
  • Work with management to optimize processes

Required Experience

  • 4 or more years experience working in financial analysis
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic and the ability to work independently
  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Knowledge of Project Management Standard and Great Plains system.
  • Prior experience in project analysis and ASC 606 revenue recognition strongly preferred
  • Prior experience in portfolio financial management and forecasting strongly preferred
  • Significant past experience in an administrative position with responsibility for audit and processing tasks
  • Ability to follow business rules and procedures while analyzing and identifying errors in processes and data
  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode

Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. title: Sales Operations Senior Manager | Samsung ADS
description:
Job Title: Sales Operations Senior Manager | Samsung ADS

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Description

We are seeking a commercially focused Senior Sales Operations Manager to lead financial operations and revenue governance across Latin America, with a strong emphasis on yield optimization, revenue forecasting and recognition, credit risk management, and business intelligence. This role plays a critical part in maintaining commercial integrity across billing, customer onboarding, financial reporting, and performance analytics. You will work closely with regional sales, global operations, legal, finance, and procurement teams to ensure operational discipline and financial accuracy.

Reporting to the Director of Operations (APAC & LATAM) based in Sydney, this role combines strategic oversight with hands-on execution. You will be responsible for managing key financial processes, including month- and year-end close, audit and compliance activities, vendor and customer governance, and commercial reporting. The position also provides leadership for Brazil-based financial operations, with a specific focus on optimizing revenue performance, managing credit exposure, and supporting cost controls aligned to Samsung Ads' regional growth objectives.

Key Job Responsabilities

Financial Operations

  • Lead operational processes related to revenue recognition, billing, and tracking against revenue and product/seller goals.
  • Develop financial and ROI models to support commercial decision-making, scenario planning, and resource optimization.
  • Oversee commercial reporting and partner payment obligations across TV Plus (O&O and licensed channels).
  • Manage agency rebate reporting and payment requirements, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and alignment with contractual terms.
  • Drive continuous reporting process improvements, including the transition to UDW.
  • Own customer onboarding workflows, collaborating with Credit and Finance to align with revenue and risk controls.
  • Oversee collections and credit exposure, supporting mitigation strategies in coordination with HQ.
  • Monitor and report on TV Plus investment ROI and OKRs, supporting performance accountability.
  • Maintain accurate commercial documentation, including sales agreements, guarantees, and bespoke terms.
  • Support operational systems administration across sales, finance, and reporting platforms.
  • Partner with business leads to identify cost savings and operational efficiencies across LATAM.

Financial Analytics

  • Leverage internal data to build audience, yield, and pricing models that support monetization strategies.
  • Create performance dashboards that track sales inputs (e.g., Salesforce activity) and outcomes (e.g., AE pacing to goals).
  • Lead the integration of RoW data into UDW to support global reporting alignment.
  • Own the weekly performance reporting cadence for LASBO.
  • Develop forecasting models for programmatic and direct revenue.
  • Build and maintain ROI models for evaluating commercial potential across products, regions, and channels.
  • Produce benchmarking metrics for internal QBRs and RoW performance reviews.

Sales Finance & Commercial Operations

  • Support deal pricing analysis and evaluate new product initiatives for commercial viability.
  • Manage sales pipeline forecasting across monthly, quarterly, and annual cycles.
  • Track and analyse quarterly run-rate performance, highlighting variances and pacing.
  • Review and approve annual/ad-hoc pricing, ensuring alignment to discount policies.
  • Analyse pricing guardrails, discounting behaviour, and price elasticity to optimize net revenue and sell-through.
  • Recommend strategies to improve fill rates, CPMs, and sales efficiency across all regions.
  • Oversee rate card management, including FX exposure and translation considerations.

Other Responsibilities

  • Share and embed local best practices across global teams and provide training where needed.
  • Support operational improvement initiatives and strategic projects as required.
  • Contribute to commercial feasibility assessments and market expansion efforts.
  • Liaise with HQ (SBT + VD) to localize and implement global mandates aligned to regional outcomes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or related quantitative field;
  • Experience in commercial finance, business intelligence, or operations—preferably in digital media or ad tech.
  • Advanced Excel and SQL skills; strong proficiency in BI tools (e.g., DOMO, Power BI).
  • Experience with Salesforce.
  • Proven track record operating within a global/matrix organization.
  • Excellent communication skills, attention to detail, and project ownership.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence across functions.
  • Self-starter, analytical, and capable of operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Korean is a strong advantage.

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team

Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future

Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact

Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

  • Professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for career advancement
  • Global networking and collaboration

About WiseVAs

WiseVAs is a premium staffing agency specializing in connecting exceptional remote professionals with businesses seeking top-tier talent. We pride ourselves on our rigorous vetting process and ability to match clients with highly skilled virtual executives.

The Opportunity

As a SDR, you will take charge of outbound prospecting efforts, managing a pipeline of 200-250 daily activities. Your role will focus on making cold calls, navigating gatekeepers, and setting appointments for our closers. Success will be based on your ability to schedule high-quality appointments while managing a strategic outreach approach over a 3-4 month sales cycle.

You will be expected to handle objections professionally, follow a structured process, and ensure that all activities are tracked meticulously. If you are analytical, able to follow rules, and focus on precision and efficiency, we want you to join our team.

Your Responsibilities

  • Make cold calls to facilities managers, navigating gatekeepers and targeting key decision-makers.
  • Manage a high-volume pipeline, following up on leads and ensuring efficient scheduling of appointments.
  • Deliver brief and impactful value propositions to prospects.
  • Schedule appointments for the closing team and ensure timely follow-up on all activities.
  • Track all interactions and maintain organized records in the CRM system.
  • Handle objections in a professional manner, ensuring smooth and productive conversations.
  • Work 40 hours per week, meeting success metrics based on the volume and quality of appointments set.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong English communication skills, with a professional phone demeanor.
  • Previous experience in cold calling and appointment setting.
  • Proven ability to manage a high-volume pipeline and engage in back-and-forth dialogues with prospects.
  • Experience with CRM or tracking systems to manage leads effectively.
  • Reliability to commit to 40 hours per week.
  • No healthcare industry experience required (scripts will be provided).

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You are uncomfortable working in a high-urgency, fast-paced environment.
  • You prefer not to follow structured processes or workflows.
  • You struggle with multi-tasking and managing a large volume of leads.

title: Analista de Compras Sênior
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA! Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.

Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui.

Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Compras Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe com atuação na empresa GREENCAR. Atuando de forma estratégica na gestão e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, contribuindo para a eficiência e competitividade dos nossos processos de aquisição.

  • Gerir fornecedores, garantindo qualidade, prazos e cumprimento de contratos;

NOSSA HISTÓRIA

Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.

Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.

Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.

title: Public Relations Account Coordinator
description:
Esenca is a strategic communications agency based in Brazil. We work with companies across Latin America to design and execute PR, content, and brand experience strategies. Our clients range from startups to large companies in tech, crypto, and finance. We move fast, we work close to the business, and we focus on building strong, relevant brands.

We’re looking for a Public Relations Coordinator to join our team. You’ll be responsible for planning, coordinating, and, when necessary, executing strategies for media and stakeholder engagement, strengthening the brand’s reputation with the press and other relevant audiences, working across different client accounts, and supporting the day-to-day of the PR manager.

Main Responsibilities

• Team Coordination

Work collaboratively with external communications teams, guiding and contributing to the effective execution of daily tasks such as planning, press release distribution, pitch suggestions, article production, meeting notes and agendas, reports, and other PR-related routines.

• Strategic PR Planning

Develop and implement institutional communication plans focused on public relations initiatives.

• Press and Media Management

Build and maintain relationships with journalists, influencers, columnists, and media outlets.

Review, guide, and, when needed, write and distribute press releases, official statements, and institutional articles.

Guide and coordinate interviews, media briefings, press conferences, and media training for spokespeople.

• Crisis Management

Act proactively and reactively in reputation crisis situations, developing contingency plans and public response strategies.

• Institutional Relations

Guide and promote engagement efforts with partners, trade associations, government bodies, and other stakeholders.

Represent the company at events, talks, trade fairs, and strategic forums.

• Events and Brand Activations

Support or lead corporate events, inaugurations, awards, roadshows, and institutional actions involving brand image.

• Reputation Monitoring

Track and analyze media and social media mentions of the company, producing brand image performance reports.

Use clipping and media monitoring tools to report on PR campaign results.

Requirements

• Degree in Public Relations, Journalism, or Social Communication.

• Proven prior experience in leadership or coordination roles in PR.

• Established relationships with the press.

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Good communication and ability to work with different teams and clients.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong skills in crisis management and institutional positioning.

• Comfortable with fast-paced environments and multitasking.

• Knowledge of PR tools (e.g., I’Max, PressManager, Google Alerts, etc.).

• Fluent in Portuguese and English.

Compensations & Benefits

• Employment type: CLT Hybrid (remote with 2x/week in-office in Osasco/SP).

• Multibenefits allowance card.

• Life insurance.

Hiring Process

• Application review and screening based on requirements.

• First interview (in person and in English).

• Skills assessment.

• Final interview with the CEO and hiring.

description:

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.

Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil

  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist
  • Designer
  • Finance Analyst
  • FinCrime Analyst
  • Operations Manager
  • Product Manager
  • Recruiter
  • Software Engineer
  • Support Specialist

This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.

If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.

Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.

Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our .

Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.

What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.

What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently, clearly, and accurately to all levels
  • A confident, self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail

Nice to have

  • Fluency in another language
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.

By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: General Manager Brazil - Seed Technologies
description:
Nufarm. Evolving Ag.

Nufarm is a global crop protection and seeds technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and food production.

Whether it’s developing the world’s first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers.

Your Future. Fueled by Innovation

Reporting to the GM LAS, this role leads our Brazilian business end to end. You will set and execute the local commercial strategy, build a high-performing team, lift customer experience, strengthen the local supply chain, and drive the innovation pipeline to deliver both short-term results and long-term growth. This is a strong and growing business with significant future opportunities. You will also partner closely with the Nufarm Bioenergy platform lead and the Grain-to-Oil team to align and integrate plans, accelerating platform growth across Brazilian markets for the success of all portfolios.

As the GM, you will lead the Brazilian business, leveraging your expertise in the Brazilian seed industry and in-depth knowledge of business processes. Your key responsibilities include developing, refining, and implementing the three-year business strategy for the Brazilian Nufarm Seeds operations.

How You’ll Help Us Grow

  • Develop and grow the Brazilian team's commitment to prioritising health, safety and well-being
  • Lead a cross-functional leadership team of x across Brazil, Including: HR, Sales, Supply Chain, Market Development, Finance, Marketing/CX and Research & Development
  • Drive the development and implementation of the commercial strategy for the Brazilian business and grower adoption in sorghum, canola, carinata and energy cane.
  • Increase the addressable hybrid canola, sorghum, carinata and energy cane market through innovation and industry thought leadership.
  • Responsible for the P&L performance of the Brazilian Nufarm Seeds business.
  • Partner with the Nuseed Bioenergy platform lead, Global GM – Seeds and Grain-to-Oil team to integrate business plans and scale platform growth in Brazil
  • Ensure long range plans, budgets and forecasts are developed accurately and that the finance team partners with commercial and supply chain to meet the revenue and expense goals of the business.
  • Work with supply chain to ensure on-time delivery of high-quality canola seedwhile minimising obsolescence
  • Lead a thriving team across Brazil that continuously raises the bar. Work closely with managers to engage staff and build engagement while recruiting, developing and retaining top talent.
  • Work closely with local and global R&D team to support the portfolio development required. Understand and solve for the future challenges growers will face, ensuring our R&D efforts are focused on the traits we will need to successful on in future years.
  • Work with global business partners to strengthen the foundation of the business and drive for success.
  • Work to implement IBP and the surrounding analytics to ensure supply/demand decisions are made with all stakeholders in balance.
  • Work with internal and external grain-to-oil supply chain partners to identify pathways for integrating new platforms into the Brazilian business.
  • Create an enabling environment for new platforms (Bioenergy) through industry engagement and policy advocacy

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Buscamos um Cientista de Dados Sênior com profundo foco em estatística e metodologia quantitativa para se juntar à nossa equipe. O profissional será responsável por liderar a aplicação de técnicas estatísticas robustas na análise de dados complexos, transformando grandes volumes de informação em insights estratégicos e modelos preditivos de alta precisão. Esta função é crucial para garantir a validade científica e a interpretabilidade de todas as nossas soluções de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Modelagem Estatística: Projetar, desenvolver e validar modelos estatísticos (regressão, séries temporais, modelos lineares generalizados, etc.) e algoritmos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio complexos.
  • Análise Preditiva e Prescritiva: Liderar análises aprofundadas usando técnicas estatísticas para previsão de tendências, segmentação de clientes, otimização de processos e avaliação de risco.
  • Teste de Hipóteses e Experimentação (A/B Testing): Conduzir o design de experimentos (DOE) e realizar testes A/B rigorosos, aplicando testes de significância estatística para medir o impacto e a eficácia de novas funcionalidades ou estratégias.
  • Validação e Interpretabilidade: Garantir a validade estatística dos modelos e resultados, focando na interpretabilidade para que as descobertas sejam claramente comunicadas e acionáveis para as equipes de produto e executivas.
  • Manipulação e Limpeza de Dados: Trabalhar com big data , realizar ETL ( Extract, Transform, Load ) e garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas análises.
  • Comunicação de Insights : Traduzir resultados estatísticos complexos em narrativas de negócio claras, utilizando visualizações de dados eficazes e relatórios detalhados para stakeholders não-técnicos.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas quantitativas correlatas. Pós-graduação (Mestrado/Doutorado) em Estatística, Econometria ou Métodos Quantitativos é um diferencial.
  • Estatística Avançada: Domínio de métodos estatísticos, inferência, econometria, amostragem e teste de hipóteses.
  • Programação: Proficiência em Python ou R para análise de dados, estatística e desenvolvimento de modelos.
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com SQL para manipulação e extração de dados.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados ou em função quantitativa similar.

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados ( Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio ).
  • Familiaridade com Deep Learning e modelos de linguagem ( LLMs ).

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. title: Analista financeiro júnior "#982421"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. title: Senior Warehouse Supervisor - Guarulhos
description:
About the job

The Warehouse Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the logistics and transportation operations involving the Middle Mile segment of the supply chain. This role involves managing the movement of goods between distribution centers, fulfillment centers, and other key locations to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of products.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement strategies to optimize the Middle Mile supply chain operations.
  • Coordinate with carriers, freight forwarders, and transportation providers to ensure timely delivery of goods.Monitor transportation costs, performance metrics, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to drive efficiency and cost savings.
  • Collaborate with crossfunctional teams including warehouse operations, procurement, and inventory management to streamline operations.
  • Analyze transportation routes, modes of transport, and delivery schedules to improve service levels and reduce lead times.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement best practices in Middle Mile logistics operations.
  • Ensure compliance with transportation regulations and safety standards.
  • Lead and mentor a team of Middle Mile logistics specialists and coordinators.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
  • Proven experience in supply chain management, logistics, or transportation operations, with a focus on the Middle Mile segment.
  • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in transportation management systems (TMS) and supply chain software.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead a team, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices, transportation regulations, and market trends in Middle Mile logistics.
  • Certification in supply chain management or logistics (e.g., CSCMP, APICS) is a plus.
  • Experience with continuous improvement methodologies (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma) is desirable.

title: Analista Sênior de Segurança Operacional (SecOps)
description:
Somos uma empresa completa que oferece soluções financeiras para todo ecossistema de combustível, através de: Conta Digital PF, Conta Digital PJ, Corretora de Seguros, Cartão Benefícios, Cartão de Crédito, Clube de Vantagens, Folha de Pagamento, Cobrança, Asset, FIDC, entre outros. Garantir a detecção, resposta e mitigação efetiva de incidentes de segurança, atuando na operação e evolução contínua do SOC, automatizando processos e fortalecendo a resiliência cibernética da organização.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Monitorar, investigar e responder a alertas de segurança gerados por SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls e demais ferramentas do ecossistema de segurança.
  • Liderar análises de incidentes de alta complexidade e coordenar ações de contenção e remediação com outras áreas de TI.
  • Desenvolver e aprimorar playbooks e runbooks de resposta a incidentes.
  • Criar correlações e casos de uso em plataformas SIEM/SOAR (ex.: Wazuh, Sentinel, QRadar, Splunk).
  • Analisar indicadores de comprometimento (IoCs) e realizar Threat Hunting proativo.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de controles de segurança e políticas de resposta a incidentes.
  • Apoiar investigações forenses e a coleta de evidências.
  • Automatizar tarefas e integrações usando scripts (PowerShell, Python, Bash).
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos e técnicos com indicadores de desempenho (KPIs/KRIs).
  • Realizar gestão de vulnerabilidades operacionais , garantindo tratamento de falhas críticas.
  • Treinar analistas juniores e atuar como referência técnica em SecOps.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com SIEM/SOAR (ex.: Wazuh, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar).
  • Conhecimento de EDR/XDR (ex.: FortiEDR, Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike).
  • Sólido domínio de redes, TCP/IP, VPNs, DNS, proxies, firewalls e IDS/IPS.
  • Conhecimento em resposta a incidentes, threat hunting e análise forense .
  • Experiência com automações (Python, PowerShell, API REST).
  • Familiaridade com vulnerabilidade e patch management .
  • Conhecimento em sistemas operacionais (Windows, Linux) e logs de autenticação/AD.
  • Desejável certificação: GCIA, GCIH, CEH, CompTIA CySA+, AZ-500 ou similar.

Competências comportamentais

  • Raciocínio analítico e capacidade de correlação de eventos.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, inclusive com público executivo.
  • Proatividade e foco em resolução de problemas.
  • Colaboração e mentoria técnica dentro do time.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão em situações críticas.

Nossa escala é presencial de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48 na região da Henrique Schaumann próximo ao metrô Oscar Freire

About the Company

LifeStyles has a history dating back to 1905 when Eric Ansell first started making condoms in Richmond Australia.

Today LifeStyles is a Global leader in the sexual wellness sector, comprising a broad range of condoms, personal lubricants, and other related products and other products in over 60 countries.

Owning a large portfolio of trademarks, LifeStyles manufactures and commercialises its products either under leading global non-latex condom brands SKYN® under its local heroes such as LifeStyles®, Manix®, Unimil®, and Blowtex® and Control®.

Outside of branded products, the Company also supports universities, NGOs, and other organizations as part of a broader effort to promote sexual health and prevent the spread of STDs and STIs. LifeStyles owns and operates manufacturing facilities in Thailand, India and Spain, and it employs over 1,600 teammates globally.

LifeStyles Healthcare was created on September 1, 2017 , when the consortium of Humanwell Healthcare & CITIC Capital private equity purchased the Sexual Wellness division from Ansell.

As of December 1, 2022, Lifestyles is owned by Linden Capital Partners , a Chicago-based private equity firm focused on the healthcare industry.

This is an exciting time to join us. We combine century-long history with the opportunity of a new beginning as a stand-alone company - this means a new way of thinking, the opportunity to explore new horizons and the chance to make a mark in an exciting, fresh business.

LifeStyles Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are empowered professionals, and we are committed to creating a team of the world’s “best of the best.” Our business foundation is strong, among our values are Integrity and Respect, our people are highly engaged, and we are excited about a new phase in the company history. We have a focus on safety and teamwork - and we want you to join us!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
description:
Senior Technical Recruiter

About the Role:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Technical Recruiter to join our dynamic team and play a pivotal role in driving our growth. As a key member of our Talent Acquisition team, you will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and closing top-tier tech talent across the Americas.   • Stakeholder Management:

  • Provide regular updates on recruitment progress and proactively address any challenges.
  • Collaborate with the CTO to align recruitment strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Reporting and Analytics:
  • Prepare detailed daily reports on recruitment activities, bottlenecks, and performance metrics.
  • Take ownership of recruitment failures and propose effective remediation strategies.

title: En español - Senior Frontend Developer (Livewire & TALL Stack)
description:
• Desarrollador/a Frontend Senior (Livewire & TALL Stack)
  • Remoto (preferencia zona horaria UTC-3 a UTC+2)
  • Jornada completa

    • Qué hacemos

    Publica.la es una plataforma SaaS B2B utilizada por cientos de editoriales, librerías y bibliotecas en todo el mundo para gestionar y potenciar sus ventas de contenido digital.

    Nuestra plataforma multi-tenant procesa millones de transacciones en 156 países , administrando bibliotecas digitales, suscripciones y e-commerce a gran escala.

    Buscamos un/a Desarrollador/a Frontend Senior para construir interfaces de usuario atractivas, accesibles y de alto rendimiento , utilizando Livewire, Alpine.js y Tailwind CSS .

    Tu trabajo impactará directamente en la experiencia de miles de editores y millones de lectores cada día.

    Qué harás

    • Desarrollar interfaces responsive y accesibles para el panel de control de editores y herramientas administrativas.
    • Crear componentes Livewire para funcionalidades interactivas en tiempo real con renderizado del lado del servidor.
    • Implementar interacciones ligeras con Alpine.js , siguiendo principios de diseño mobile-first .
    • Estilizar interfaces con Tailwind CSS , asegurando el cumplimiento de las normas de accesibilidad WCAG 2.1 AA .
    • Trabajar con componentes Vue.js cuando se requieran interacciones complejas del lado del cliente.
    • Colaborar con el equipo backend en contratos de API e integración de componentes.
    • Optimizar el rendimiento del frontend: lazy loading , optimización de bundles, estrategias de caché.
    • Escribir tests y mantener la calidad del código con herramientas modernas.
    • Participar en revisiones de diseño y contribuir a mejoras de UI/UX .

    Stack tecnológico

    Tecnologías: Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Tailwind CSS, Vue.js

    También en el proyecto: PHP, SingleStore, Valkey/Redis, Docker, GitLab CI/CD

    Podrías encajar si tienes

    • Más de 6 años de experiencia en desarrollo frontend , con fuerte dominio de arquitecturas basadas en componentes.
    • Conocimiento profundo de Livewire , Alpine.js u otros frameworks reactivos similares (al menos 1 año de experiencia).
    • Experiencia con Tailwind CSS u otros frameworks utility-first .
    • Foco en accesibilidad (WCAG 2.1 AA) y diseño mobile-first .
    • Experiencia construyendo interfaces responsivas y de alto rendimiento para plataformas SaaS.
    • Comodidad trabajando dentro del ecosistema Laravel (se valora comprensión básica de PHP).
    • Nivel nativo o conversacional de español , y buenas habilidades de comunicación escrita en inglés y español (el 90% de nuestra comunicación es asincrónica y escrita).
    • Mentalidad proactiva y capacidad para trabajar eficazmente en un entorno remoto.
    • Portugués es un plus.

    Deseable

    • Experiencia desarrollando con Vue.js .
    • Experiencia en interfaces multi-tenant y sistemas de control de acceso basado en roles (RBAC) .
    • Conocimiento del templating de Laravel Blade y renderizado del lado del servidor.
    • Experiencia con herramientas de build modernas ( Vite , Webpack ).
    • Experiencia en testing frontend con Playwright .
    • Conocimientos en optimización de rendimiento web .
    • Experiencia trabajando con design systems y bibliotecas de componentes.
    • Contribuciones a proyectos frontend open source .

    Cómo trabajamos

    • Equipo 100% remoto distribuido en diferentes zonas horarias.
    • Comunicación asincrónica por defecto, con documentación clara y escrita.
    • Valoramos el código limpio , la accesibilidad y la mantenibilidad .
    • Enfoque en el aprendizaje continuo y actualización tecnológica constante.
    • Cuidamos la experiencia y productividad del desarrollador .
    • Entorno colaborativo donde tu opinión cuenta en decisiones clave.
    • Interacción directa con clientes para entender sus necesidades y mejorar el producto.

    Proceso de selección

    1. Conversación inicial sobre tu experiencia y objetivos profesionales.
    2. Evaluación técnica enfocada en Livewire y arquitectura de componentes.

Experiência prática em UX Design.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: VAGA PCD
description:
Sobre nós

O grupo Yokogawa, fundado no ano de 1915 em Tóquio, atualmente é líder mundial no fornecimento de soluções integradas de controle de processos. E continuamos desenvolvendo e oferecendo tecnologia no estado da arte, dentro do conceito ETS - Enterprise Technology Solutions – que significa apresentar a solução global ao cliente, pelo melhor custo/benefício.

Nosso know how internacional conta com certificação ISO:9001 e está à disposição de nossos clientes, em toda sua área de atuação, em relação à otimização da produção, dos ativos e da cadeia de suprimentos com a aplicação efetiva de tecnologias digitais, permitindo a transição para operações autônomas.

Em mais de um século de história, a Yokogawa continua trabalhando em direção a uma sociedade sustentável através de seus mais de 17.000 funcionários em uma rede global de 122 empresas que abrangem 61 países.

Requisitos:

  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Alphaville/SP (presencial ou híbrido);
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em horário adm (8h00h às 17h30) de Segunda a Sexta-feira;
  • Ensino Médio Completo.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Informática será um diferencial;
  • Ensino Técnico ou Superior cursando ou completo, será um diferencial;
  • Experiência profissional, será um diferencial.

Benefícios e mais informações

Remuneração compatível com o mercado, PLR anual, plano médico e odontológico nacional, refeitório local, previdência privada, seguro de vida, convênio SESI, presente maternidade e auxílio creche até 18 meses.

Posição CLT efetiva, jornada de segunda a sexta, das 8h às 17h30, com flexibilidade de horário e deslocamento híbrido ao site em Alphaville, Barueri/SP quando houver necessidade negociada com o gestor.

Yokogawa deseja uma cultura diversificada, equitativa e inclusiva. Recrutaremos, desenvolveremos e promoveremos ativamente pessoas de diversas origens que diferem em termos de experiência, conhecimento, estilos de pensamento, perspectiva, formação cultural e status socioeconômico. Não discriminaremos com base na raça, cor da pele, idade, sexo, identidade e expressão de género, orientação sexual, religião, crença, opinião política, nacionalidade, etnia, local de origem, deficiência, relações familiares ou quaisquer outras circunstâncias. A Yokogawa valoriza as diferenças e permite que todos pertençam, contribuam, tenham sucesso e demonstrem todo o seu potencial.

Ao se candidatar a esta vaga, você reconhece e concorda que a Yokogawa colete, utilize e processe seus dados pessoais para fins de recrutamento. Isso inclui a avaliação da sua adequação para a posição anunciada e a gestão de procedimentos administrativos relacionados.

Além disso, quando necessário, seus dados poderão ser compartilhados com prestadores de serviços terceirizados autorizados para a realização dessas verificações, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos legais e regulatórios aplicáveis.

A Yokogawa está comprometida em proteger sua privacidade e em tratar seus dados pessoais com os mais altos padrões de segurança e confidencialidade. Ao prosseguir com sua candidatura, você confirma que leu e compreendeu esta declaração e consente com a coleta, uso, divulgação e processamento de seus dados pessoais conforme descrito.

title: On-Site IT Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.

Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance, ensuring uptime and reliability.

Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.

Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.

Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.

Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.

Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.

Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.

Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles.

Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals.

Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.

Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks.

Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.

Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.

Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Monitoring Specialist
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and
Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to level up your career?

Playtech Managed Services Sao Paulo is looking for a proactive Monitoring Specialist with excellent communication, attention to detail, reaction time and problem-solving skills. Job Description

Your influential mission. You will...

  • Perform Monitoring, Incident Management, Redundancy and Incident Reporting activities.
  • Work on shifts (16/7 coverage ).
  • Monitor multiple business systems and detect incidents across multiple service dependencies.
  • React by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type.
  • Coordinate incident communication with multiple parties.
  • Familiarize yourself with Incident Management documentation.
  • Learn the company products at a technical and operational level, including backend settings, integrations and monitoring dashboards.
  • Liase with third parties during Incident Management.
  • Understand how the environments and available configurations work.
  • Acquire insight into Incident Management processes in a global company.
  • Communicate daily with other teams in and outside the company.
  • Constantly develop skills and get new knowledge in the Incident Management domain.
  • Carry out investigations to determine Incident root causes.
Qualifications

Components for success. You...

  • Are willing to develop your career in Incident Management.
  • You have previous experience in Monitoring, Incident Management or a similar role (1 year minimum, 2 or more years recommended).
  • Possess knowledge of Monitoring and Incident Reporting methodologies and processes.
  • Have good written and verbal communication skills in English and you can communicate with team members, clients, and stakeholders in English.

You'll get extra points for...

  • Having experience working with Grafana or similar tools
Additional Information

Thrive in a culture that values...

  • A supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A commitment to innovation and excellence.
  • A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome.
  • Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation.

HOW TO APPLY?

In addition to your CV, please add a brief motivation letter covering your goals, your current experience in Monitoring or related fields, and/or working in a corporate environment. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

MONITORING TEAM

The Monitoring Team is a crucial part of the Incident Report Operational Center (IROC). The team is dedicated to centralizing incident monitoring, detection, and initial response across all relevant systems. Our mission is to ensure business continuity and protect customer experience by proactively managing incidents. The team monitors all business systems, detects incidents across multiple service dependencies, and reacts by executing appropriate redundancy protocols based on service type. We manage incident communication and documentation across all service types and criticality levels.

Our team operates 16/7, ensuring immediate response and detailed incident reporting, documenting all actions and outcomes for transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in incident management.

Join the team at our new Brazilian Playtech Managed Services (PTMS) office, where we work together to support and enhance our live products and services. Be part of a global, dynamic and innovative team that values collaboration, continuous learning, and excellence.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Avaliar as solicitações de alterações e adequações dos processos pela SIG global, de forma a manter contato com os pares globais da posição.
  • Ter conhecimento sólido na documentação SIG para poder disseminar os procedimentos e instruções técnicas, desafiar e/ou modificar (baseando-se em conceitos assépticos), além de ser referência para essas consultas pelo time técnico em especial, FSEs.
  • Ser mentor no desenvolvimento das competências técnicas dos consultores de qualidade e time de serviços técnicos.
  • Atuar com o time global da empresa em grupos de trabalho focado em melhorias preventivas no sistema de envase SIG na busca da redução dos índices de reclamações de mercado (MCR).
  • Atuar proativamente desde o desenvolvimento das embalagens, fabricação, envase e clientes para promover a criação da Cultura de Qualidade end to end .

Suas habilidades, experiência e formação

  • Superior completo em Engenharia de Alimentos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em Gestão de Qualidade e Segurança de Alimentos;
  • Vivência em indústria de alimentos, preferencialmente em indústria de lácteos ou sucos;
  • Inglês avançado (interface com time global);
  • Espanhol intermediário (interface com time AM-S);
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (100% do tempo em clientes AM-S).

O que nós oferecemos

  • Salário competitivo com o mercado
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • PPR
  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • WellHub
  • Subsídio a estudo (de acordo com política específica)
  • Auxílio creche e outros.

Competências da SIG

Estamos procurando por pessoas que estejam buscando alcançar resultados de forma consistente, mesmo sob circunstâncias difíceis. Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Você é alguém que aplica conhecimento de negócios e mercado para promover os objetivos da organização? Você é alguém capaz de criar novas e melhores maneiras de a organização ter sucesso? Se a resposta é “sim”, venha e junte-se a nós.

Nosso Compromisso

A SIG é o lugar onde você pode construir algo incrível. Nós oferecemos uma remuneração competitiva e a oportunidade de trabalho remoto em regime parcial. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira; um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. Você fará parte de uma equipe altamente motivada e dinâmica, e terá oportunidades de desenvolvimento pessoal, além de capacitação e orientação profissional junto de colegas de equipe experientes. Se você mostrar que é capaz e tem vontade de aprender, nós lhe daremos todo o apoio.

Sobre a SIG

A SIG é líder em sistemas de embalagens e soluções. Trabalhamos em parceria com nossos clientes para levar alimentos aos consumidores de todo o mundo de forma segura, sustentável e acessível. Somos o único fornecedor de um sistema de embalagens que trabalha com embalagens cartonadas e dos tipos pouches e bag-in-box. Nossa tecnologia versátil e nossas habilidades em inovação de produto nos permitem entregar o melhor para nossos clientes, nossos consumidores e para o mundo. A sustentabilidade nos guia, a tecnologia nos capacita, mas é a paixão e a motivação de nossa gente que realmente nos inspira a entregar o melhor.

Fundada em 1853, a SIG possui sua sede em Neuhausen, na Suíça, e está listada na Bolsa de Valores SIX Swiss Exchange.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.

About the Role

We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.

Key Responsibilities

Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.

Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.

Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin , an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.

This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.   

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.

What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

  • Auxiliar na implementação de práticas seguras no ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex: validação de entrada, logs estruturados, gestão de segredos);
  • Colaborar pontualmente com times de segurança na integração de ferramentas e coleta de evidências para auditoria ou resposta a incidentes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para participar desta seleção, nossa expectativa é de que você tenha:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Análise e desenvolvimento de sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.
  • Experiência prática com desenvolvimento back end (ex: Python, Node.js, Go ou similares);
  • Conhecimento sólido em construção de pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.);
  • Vivência com containers (Docker), Kubernetes, e versionamento com Git;
  • Familiaridade com automação de tarefas e integração de APIs;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais ou NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com sistema operacional Linux e Virtualização.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Conhecimentos básicos de segurança em aplicações web (OWASP, autenticação segura, etc.);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação como Ansible, Terraform ou similares;
  • Noções de práticas DevOps/SRE: observabilidade, logging estruturado;
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de gestão de segredos (Vault, Doppler, AWS Secrets Manager).

E aí, deu match!? Então vem fazer parte do nosso time de secpowers ! ⚡

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Ambiência- Arquitetura
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Atividades:

  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;

  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.

  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst (Graduated from 2022-2025)
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore , Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.

Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.

Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)

Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.

title: Estagiário
description:
A NEUMAN & ESSER impulsiona a transição energética e a economia circular com confiabilidade e soluções integradas para a infraestrutura de energia do futuro. Nossas soluções em compressão, com tecnologia própria de vedação, são usadas no processamento industrial de gases, tanto na indústria tradicional de petróleo e gás, como na economia do hidrogênio verde. O portfólio de produtos também inclui sistemas de produção de hidrogênio sustentável, como eletrolisadores e reformadores, as principais tecnologias para a demanda futura por energia limpa.

Com mais de um século de experiência na compressão de hidrogênio, a NEUMAN & ESSER é hoje a especialista em toda a cadeia de valor de H2. Quando se trata de dar vida a projetos ambiciosos, a NEUMAN & ESSER é o seu parceiro - desde a avaliação de potenciais plantas, viabilidade e financiamento do projeto, passando pela engenharia, construção e comissionamento, até à comercialização dos gases produzidos. Nossas soluções em engenharia de processos mecânicos apresentam diferenciais expressivos para a moagem e classificação de matérias-primas e materiais reciclados. Os nossos sistemas demonstram uma contribuição essencial em aplicações como tinta em pó e enriquecimento protéico, bem como na produção de materiais de alta performance para sistemas de armazenamento de energia em baterias.

A confiabilidade e a disponibilidade são a base de parcerias de longo prazo e são garantidas em nossas plantas com um serviço digital 360° durante a operação. A continuidade de uma empresa familiar com quase 200 anos e a nossa rede global de fabricação, vendas e serviços, garantem a proximidade junto aos nossos clientes. Seja em projetos envolvendo máquinas novas, seja na área de serviços, peças OEM ou qualquer atividade de pós-vendas, estamos perto do nosso cliente. Orientados a soluções ágeis, criativas e inovadoras, desenvolvemos o conhecimento dos nossos mais de 1.700 colaboradores para atender as necessidades do mercado.

Se você busca se desenvolver profissionalmente, com habilidades inovadoras venha fazer parte da NEUMAN & ESSER .

O que buscamos em seu perfil :

Estudantes de graduação em Engenharia Mecânica ou Engenharia Mecatrônica, do 2º ao 6º período.

Requisitos:

● Conhecimento de desenho técnico industrial;
